sources.supportingExcerpt: Cidadãos de 98 países estão isentos de visto para entrar em Angola.

policies.title: Listed ordinary passports: Angola tourist-visa exemption
policies.summary: Presidential Decree 189/23 expressly lists 98 beneficiary countries. Ninety-six map to this repository’s passport catalog; Cook Islands and Niue have no separate codes in that catalog. The Philippines is handled by the separate current Government confirmation of the later amendment.
conditions: Up to 30 days per entry and 90 days per calendar year.
Passport validity of more than six months and, where needed, an international vaccination certificate remain required.
This policy does not establish work, study, medical-treatment, residence, business-specific, transit, crew, diplomatic, official/service, special-document or individual admissibility treatment.

policies.title: Philippine ordinary passports: Angola tourist-visa exemption
policies.summary: A current Government/CIPRA retrospective identifies the Presidential instrument integrating the Philippines into Angola’s tourist-visa-exemption regime. The original regime’s tourism-only purpose and ordinary border formalities continue to limit this classification.
conditions: Tourist visits only; the Government source does not establish work, study, medical-treatment, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official/service or special-document treatment.
The reviewed current Government confirmation establishes the current inclusion but does not publish the amending decree’s operative-text PDF or a precise effective date; no date is normalized here.
Normal border admission and document requirements remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: Presidential Decree 189/23 expressly lists Samoa among the tourist-visa-exempt countries; the current official 98-country confirmations show the regime remains in place.
